pages.title: A Little Enchantment
pages.text: Apply an enchantment at an Enchanting Table.

pages.title: A Little Enchantment
pages.text: Learn a useful everyday system alongside spells; lapis supports later choices.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Supply an eligible item and lapis, choose an available offer and finish the paid native operation. Retained table slots are convenience, not a separate requirement.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Insert lapis and the target item, then close the interface. Inputs remain inside and appear floating around the table.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Use the reroll control with its required lapis and experience available. The offered enchantments change for a configured lapis/experience-point cost.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Place non-colliding decorations between bookshelves and table and inspect available enchanting power. The author allows non-colliding blocks where vanilla expects air; required bookshelf count is configurable.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Compare installed enchanting mods against the author's Apotheosis/Quark matrix-enchanter warning. The warning identifies an integration boundary without proving those mods or conflicts exist in JEM.
